messages:
Aisha Khan: i'm signing off in ~25m — Tom primary, Jin secondary for the night. please confirm pd, aws, grafana, and the emergency runbooks are reachable. note any gaps here so i can handoff cleanly.
Tom Reed: on it. i can cover the EU/US overlap until 22:30 PT. dashboards look green right now. anyone seen residual rate-limit spikes from the morning deploy?
Aisha Khan: nothing active. morning rollout had a transient proxy 502 loop that was mitigated by rollback. runbook we used is the 'proxy-rollback' section in the oncall guide. link: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff.md
Jin Park: quick heads-up — i still can't assume the cross-account role for the private cluster. trying:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/OncallCrossAccount --role-session-name jin-night
```
returns `AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole`.
Marta Li: thanks for flagging. checking trust policy now. i think the org-wide role binding missed the SRE team group. i'll patch TF and kick a deploy. ping me if you need console access meanwhile.
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Reminder: please run the oncall acknowledgement within 10 minutes to avoid PagerDuty auto-escalation.
Tom Reed: acknowledged the bot. i can also open the Grafana alert test if you want to verify the PD route.
Aisha Khan: please do that after Marta confirms the PD token. Jin — if role doesn't land before an incident, use the oncall-jump host path (requires MFA) to reach the private cluster.
Jin Park: i don't have the hardware MFA key on me. can we add a temporary SSH jump rule for my user for tonight only?
Marta Li: i won't add long-lived exceptions. i'm updating the role now — patch id #6543, plan id plan-1976 — applying in 90s. if it fails i'll DM an escalation ticket to secops.
Tom Reed: noted. do we have permission to run the emergency fanout runbook? i can trigger it but want to make sure i have the right scope for feature flags in prod.
Aisha Khan: primary can run the fanout, but toggling feature flags requires the FF-admin permission. Tom, you have FF-admin for inference-runtime, right?
Tom Reed: yep, confirmed. i can toggle and monitor canary. also i can simulate the webhook to PD once Marta verifies the Grafana contact point.
Marta Li: checking PagerDuty integration now — looks like the Grafana token rotated during key rotation last week. secret path is `secret/data/integrations/pagerduty/grafana`. i'll rotate and update. will post Vault txn id.
Jin Park: thanks. role just applied for me — assume-role now works. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: if primary is inactive for >10m, PD will page the secondary automatically.
Aisha Khan: great. i'm leaving notes in the runbook under 'night-handoff' with current status and the steps we took. ping me if anything blocks you in the next hour. i'll be reachable by DM unless there's a page.
Tom Reed: got it. leaving phone ringer on, monitoring alerts channel. good handoff, team.
